notes.sv: Stödjer barns vård och uppfostran, utbildning, behövande personer i främst före detta Älvsborgs län samt medicinsk forskning. Ansökan skickas per post på stiftelsens blankett.
notes.en: Supports child care and upbringing, education, people in need mainly in the former Älvsborg county, and medical research. Applications are posted on the foundation's form.
